messages:
Anna (support): FYI ACME-INC is hitting 403s that look like 'invalid API key' after we migrated them from legacy SSO -> org billing. They can't create API keys either. Customer-facing, noticed ~10m ago. Repro + logs below.

Mike (eng-runtime): Can you paste the gateway trace id and the raw entitlement response?

Anna (support): Trace is tr_0a1b2c3d. Repro steps: 1) SSO->org migration completed in console 2) call POST /v1/chat with Authorization: Bearer <token from SSO exchange> 3) receive 403 UI shows "Invalid API key".

Anna (support): Gateway log snippet:
```
[2026-03-16T20:11:22Z] trace=tr_0a1b2c3d tenant=acme-inc auth=ok auth_method=oauth
[2026-03-16T20:11:22Z] entitlement_check -> status=403 body={"error":"plan_blocked","code":"plan_required","message":"team needs Pro plan to use API"}
[2026-03-16T20:11:22Z] response_to_client -> status=403 body={"error":"invalid_api_key","message":"Invalid API key"}
```

Mike (eng-runtime): Ugh. So gateway gets a 403 from entitlement but maps everything to invalid_api_key. That mapping should only be for certain auth failures. We need to surface the entitlement reason so console and SDKs can show upgrade flow.

Jasper (billing): The billing service just returned code=plan_required. ACME is on "team-trial" which expires tomorrow; the migration should have auto-converted them to the free plan but maybe SKU mapping failed. Looking up their subscription now.

Luis (identity): Quick check — during SSO migration we add claims: {org_id, plan_sku, seats}. If plan_sku is missing, entitlement service may default to deny. Can you dump the SAML/OIDC claim for that user?

Anna (support): Pasted the token claims (redacted):
```
{"sub":"u_123","org_id":"acme-inc","email":"ops@acme.com","roles":["admin"]}
```
No plan_sku present.

Luis (identity): That explains it — claim omission. The identity migration job should populate plan_sku from billing. Looks like a race: billing migration to mark org as free happened, identity job ran before billing write finished so claim missing. Entitlement service treated missing plan as not allowed.

Mike (eng-runtime): Two things: 1) fix mapping in gateway so entitlement 403 returns a structured error e.g. {"error":"plan_block","reason":"plan_required"} and SDKs show upgrade CTA; 2) temporary support workaround: surface the entitlement message to the customer instead of invalid_api_key so they know why.

Jasper (billing): I can force-sync acme-inc subscription now to ensure plan_sku present. Doing that and will post once done.

ops-bot: Deploy start: infra/entitlement-cache-bust v1.2.3 by luis at 2026-03-16T20:19:05Z :rocket:

Jasper (billing): Sync complete. Confirmed subscription row present: sku=team-free, seats=5.

Luis (identity): Re-ran identity claim refresh for org. New claim payload includes plan_sku=team-free.

Mike (eng-runtime): I pushed a small gateway change to stop mapping arbitrary entitlement 403s to invalid_api_key and instead forward the entitlement body. Rolling in prod now.

ops-bot: Deploy success: infra/gateway v3.14.1 by mike at 2026-03-16T20:24:38Z :white_check_mark:

Anna (support): Re-tested with customer token — now response is 403 with body: {"error":"plan_blocked","message":"team requires Pro plan to use API"}. Customer now sees upgrade prompt in console. They were able to create an API key after we re-synced their subscription (they had to be converted to free plan explicitly).

Mike (eng-runtime): Root cause summary: race during migration left identity claims missing plan_sku -> entitlement service default-denied -> gateway incorrectly mapped entitlement 403 -> surfaced as invalid_api_key.

Jasper (billing): Follow-ups: 1) add stronger ordering/locking for billing->identity migration, 2) add automated check that plan_sku is present after migration, 3) quick audit to find any other orgs with empty plan_sku. I'll open ENG-IR-512 for tracking.

Luis (identity): I'll add a retry in identity job and emit a metric when claim fields are missing.

Anna (support): Customer notified and handed off to account team for upsell/clarification. Marking thread resolved from support side.

Mike (eng-runtime): Moving to postmortem on ENG board. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
